characters.name: BitBot
characters.intro: Explorer! Spark City needs your brain power!
characters.correct: Excellent thinking! You looked at the goal before making the choice.
characters.retry: No worries! Great Explorers test another idea.
characters.levelUp: Whoa! Your knowledge just powered up the Quantum Grid!

characters.name: Nova
characters.intro: Hi Explorer! I'm Nova. Let's turn a small idea into a big goal.
characters.correct: That's a smart strategy. You connected today's choice to tomorrow's goal.
characters.retry: Let's slow down and think about what matters most.
characters.levelUp: Your goal-setting skills are getting stronger!

characters.name: Vex
characters.intro: Hey Explorer, I'm Vex. Let's find a smart way to grow your Spark Coins.
characters.correct: Nice move — that's exactly how a savings pod fills up over time.
characters.retry: No rush. Saving is a marathon, not a sprint — try another plan.
characters.levelUp: Your savings strategy just leveled up!

characters.name: Pip
characters.intro: I'm Pip! Before you spend those Spark Coins, let's think it through.
characters.correct: Great call — you weighed it before you spent it.
characters.retry: Careful, Explorer — let's look at that choice one more time.
characters.levelUp: You just unlocked smarter spending instincts!

characters.name: Astra
characters.intro: I'm Astra. I show up when the whole crew's missions are done for the day.
characters.correct: The crew's proud of you — that's a full day of smart choices.
characters.retry: Keep going, Explorer — the crew's still cheering for you.
characters.levelUp: Crew complete! Astra's Badge is yours.
